data.title: 大学阶梯教室的第一束晨光
data.location: 晨光斜照的大学木质阶梯教室
data.lighting: 高窗斜射冷暖交替清晨日光
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, oatmeal chunky knit long cardigan, white collared shirt, charcoal checkered midi skirt, black tights, sitting at wooden lecture desk, sliding annotated notebook across desk without looking up, holding fountain pen, faint blush on ear, composed expression, university lecture hall, tiered wooden desks, tall side windows, angled morning sunlight beam, dust motes, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Without glancing up from her fountain pen, she slides her neatly annotated notebook across the lecture desk toward your seat. Crisp morning sunlight from the tall hall windows catches her reddening ear and the bright pages between you.
data.promptProse: Viewed from the neighboring seat in a quiet university lecture hall before class begins, Shiki Natsume sits upright in an oatmeal chunky-knit cardigan layered over a white collared shirt, charcoal checkered midi skirt, and black tights. Keeping her eyes deliberately fixed on her textbook with a pen poised in one hand, she uses the other to push a neatly highlighted notebook across the long wooden desk toward the viewer, only the warm flush along her ear betraying her care as crisp morning sunlight slices diagonally through the tall windows.
data.story: 早课铃还没响，阶梯教室里只有翻书声。夏目目不斜视地转着钢笔，却顺手把划满红蓝重点的笔记往你这边推了半寸，晨光恰好落到她微微发红的耳尖上——「昨天又熬夜了吧？别误会，我只是不想被你拖累小组作业。」
